description_good_justification: README.md succinctly describes the project as a reusable template and boilerplate for native C/C++, GPU, and FFmpeg-filter projects, providing a cross-cutting engineering layer alongside minimal seed and multi-backend GPU dispatch examples. Evidence: README.md
interact_justification: README.md details how to obtain and build the software via Meson, SUPPORT.md outlines issue reporting and discussions, and CONTRIBUTING.md describes the contribution workflow. Evidence: README.md, SUPPORT.md, CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents the contribution workflow, including branch conventions, pull request requirements, CODEOWNERS reviews, and status check gating. Evidence: https://github.com/golusoris/template-native-gpu/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: Contribution standards are documented in CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/principles.md, requiring Power-of-10 and SEI CERT-C rules, Google C++ style formatting, append-only ABI maintenance, and zero static analysis warnings. Evidence: https://github.com/golusoris/template-native-gpu/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md https://github.com/golusoris/template-native-gpu/blob/main/docs/principles.md
floss_license_justification: All software produced by the project is released under the EUPL-1.2 license, with FFmpeg patches released under LGPL-2.1-or-later, both of which are approved FLOSS licenses. Evidence: LICENSE, NOTICE, docs/adr/0005-eupl-licence.md
floss_license_osi_justification: The project's software licenses, EUPL-1.2 and LGPL-2.1-or-later, are approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI). Evidence: LICENSE, LICENSES/EUPL-1.2.txt, LICENSES/LGPL-2.1-or-later.txt
license_location_justification: The main license is posted in the top-level LICENSE file, individual component licenses reside in the LICENSES/ directory per REUSE specifications, and REUSE.toml maps file licenses. Evidence: https://github.com/golusoris/template-native-gpu/blob/main/LICENSE https://github.com/golusoris/template-native-gpu/blob/main/LICENSES/EUPL-1.2.txt
documentation_basics_justification: Basic documentation covering software installation, building, testing, directory layout, and usage is provided in README.md and docs/development/build.md, with security instructions in SECURITY.md. Evidence: README.md, docs/development/build.md, SECURITY.md
documentation_interface_justification: The external C interface and binary interop ABI data structures, functions, return codes, and payload formats are documented in docs/api/interop-abi.md and the public headers in libproject/include/project/. Evidence: docs/api/interop-abi.md, libproject/include/project/interop.h, libproject/include/project/project.h
sites_https_justification: The repository website and all documentation URLs use HTTPS exclusively. Evidence: GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01 (html_url: https://github.com/golusoris/template-native-gpu), README.md
discussion_justification: The project provides public, searchable, URL-addressable discussion forums via GitHub Discussions, GitHub Issues, and GitHub Pull Requests. Evidence: GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01 (has_discussions: true, has_issues: true), SUPPORT.md
english_justification: All project documentation, issue forms, pull request templates, code comments, and commit messages are in English. Evidence: README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml
maintained_justification: The project is actively maintained with 22 merged pull requests, commits through October 2026, automated dependency updates via Renovate, and active CI workflows. Evidence: GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01 (pushed_at: 2026-10-30T05:05:58Z, prs merged: 22), git log, renovate.json
repo_public_justification: The source code repository is publicly accessible on GitHub at https://github.com/golusoris/template-native-gpu. Evidence: GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01, README.md
repo_track_justification: The project uses Git to record code changes, authorship, timestamps, commit messages, and cryptographic commit signatures. Evidence: git log, GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01 (ruleset: required_signatures)
repo_interim_justification: The Git repository records interim development commits and branch pull requests rather than publishing only final release archives. Evidence: git log, GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01 (prs merged: 22), .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
repo_distributed_justification: The repository is managed with Git, a distributed version control system. Evidence: git status, GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01
version_unique_justification: Every change has a unique git commit SHA, and release-please assigns each release a unique SemVer version tracked in .release-please-manifest.json and release-please-config.json.
version_semver_justification: The project explicitly adheres to Semantic Versioning (SemVer) 2.0.0, as stated in CHANGELOG.md and configured in release-please-config.json and meson.build. Evidence: CHANGELOG.md, release-please-config.json, meson.build
version_tags_justification: No release tag exists yet (repository tags: none, read 2026-11-01); release-please-config.json and .github/workflows/release-please.yml create v-prefixed tags once a release is cut.
release_notes_justification: No release has been published yet (repository releases and tags: none, read 2026-11-01); CHANGELOG.md holds only an [Unreleased] section, maintained by release-please from release-please-config.json.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No release has been published and no vulnerability has been fixed or reported (repository security advisories: none, read 2026-11-01).
report_process_justification: Bug reports are submitted via GitHub Issues using the structured issue form in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml, as documented in SUPPORT.md and CONTRIBUTING.md. Evidence: https://github.com/golusoris/template-native-gpu/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml https://github.com/golusoris/template-native-gpu/blob/main/SUPPORT.md
report_tracker_justification: The project uses GitHub Issues to track individual bug reports, feature requests, and maintenance tasks. Evidence: GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01 (has_issues: true), .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml, SUPPORT.md
report_responses_justification: No bug report was submitted in the last 12 months (repository issues: 0, read 2026-11-01); reports go through .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml as described in SUPPORT.md.
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement request was submitted in the last 12 months (repository issues: 0, read 2026-11-01); requests go through .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml.
report_archive_justification: All issue reports, enhancement requests, comments, and project responses are publicly and permanently archived on GitHub Issues. Evidence: https://github.com/golusoris/template-native-gpu/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml https://github.com/golusoris/template-native-gpu/blob/main/SUPPORT.md
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: https://github.com/golusoris/template-native-gpu/blob/main/SECURITY.md describes the reporting process, but its channels are still template placeholders (your-org/myproject advisory URL, security@example.com) and GitHub private vulnerability reporting is disabled in the repository settings, so no working channel is published.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md names only placeholder channels (your-org/myproject advisory URL, security@example.com), and GitHub private vulnerability reporting is disabled in the repository settings (read 2026-11-01).
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability report was received in the last 6 months: the repository has zero security advisories and zero issues (GitHub API, read 2026-11-01).
build_justification: The project provides an automated build system using Meson and Ninja that compiles the C library, shaders, and tests from source code. Evidence: meson.build, libproject/meson.build, Makefile
build_common_tools_justification: The software is built using standard, widely used tools for C/C++ development: Meson, Ninja, and GNU Make. Evidence: meson.build, Makefile, README.md
build_floss_tools_justification: The software is buildable using exclusively FLOSS tooling: Meson (Apache-2.0), Ninja (Apache-2.0), and GCC (GPL-3.0+) or Clang (Apache-2.0 with LLVM Exception). Evidence: meson.build, Makefile, .github/workflows/ci.yml
test_justification: An automated FLOSS test suite is provided and executed via meson test, with instructions documented in README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md and executed in CI. Evidence: libproject/test/meson.build, README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, .github/workflows/ci.yml
test_invocation_justification: The test suite is invoked through standard C/Meson commands (meson test -C build) and standard Makefile targets (make test). Evidence: meson.build, Makefile, CONTRIBUTING.md
test_most_justification: Automated test fixtures in libproject/test/interop_test.c exercise core ABI pack/unpack logic, forward compatibility, absent sections, and error conditions across the public API surface. Evidence: libproject/test/interop_test.c, libproject/test/meson.build
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: Continuous integration runs via GitHub Actions on every push and pull request, executing build matrices, test suites, and sanitizers. Evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/sanitizers.yml, GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01
test_policy_justification: The project maintains an explicit policy requiring automated tests for new functionality, documented in CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md (HISS-15), and docs/principles.md. Evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, docs/principles.md
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes and features in git history include automated test fixtures and test scripts, such as interop ABI tests and CI verification scripts. Evidence: git log, libproject/test/interop_test.c, scripts/ci/
tests_documented_added_justification: The policy requiring tests for change proposals is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md and enforced in .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md. Evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md, .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
warnings_justification: Compiler warnings are strictly enabled in meson.build using warning_level=3 and werror=true, and separate linter tools (clang-tidy, cppcheck) are configured. Evidence: meson.build, .clang-tidy, .pre-commit-config.yaml
warnings_fixed_justification: The project enforces zero compiler warnings across all builds via werror=true in meson.build and requires clean clang-tidy and linter runs before merge. Evidence: meson.build, CONTRIBUTING.md, .github/workflows/ci.yml
warnings_strict_justification: The project enables maximally strict warning flags in meson.build, including warning_level=3, werror=true, -Wshadow, -Wpointer-arith, -Wstrict-prototypes, -Wmissing-prototypes, and -Wvla. Evidence: meson.build
know_secure_design_justification: Maintainers design the software following core security principles, including fail-safe defaults, input validation allowlists, least privilege in CI permissions, and defensive ABI bounds checking. Evidence: docs/principles.md, SECURITY.md, libproject/src/interop.c, .github/workflows/ci.yml
know_common_errors_justification: Maintainers understand common C/C++ vulnerability classes and counter them using SEI CERT-C rules, bounded operations, ASan/UBSan/TSan sanitizers, and static analysis sweeps. Evidence: docs/principles.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, .github/workflows/sanitizers.yml
crypto_published_justification: The software produced by the project does not directly implement or use cryptographic algorithms or protocols. Evidence: docs/principles.md, libproject/src/interop.c, meson.build
crypto_call_justification: The software produced by the project does not implement or require cryptographic functionality. Evidence: docs/principles.md, libproject/src/interop.c
crypto_floss_justification: The software produced by the project does not contain or depend on cryptographic features. Evidence: docs/principles.md, meson.build
crypto_keylength_justification: The software produced by the project contains no security mechanisms that utilize cryptographic keys. Evidence: docs/principles.md, libproject/src/interop.c
crypto_working_justification: The software produced by the project contains no security mechanisms that depend on cryptographic ciphers or algorithms. Evidence: docs/principles.md, libproject/src/interop.c
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The software produced by the project does not use cryptographic algorithms or modes. Evidence: docs/principles.md, libproject/src/interop.c
crypto_pfs_justification: The software produced by the project does not implement network protocols or key agreement mechanisms. Evidence: docs/principles.md, libproject/src/interop.c
crypto_password_storage_justification: The software produced by the project does not authenticate external users or store passwords. Evidence: docs/principles.md, libproject/src/interop.c
crypto_random_justification: The software produced by the project does not generate cryptographic keys or nonces; simulation random number generation uses deterministic, seedable RNG per SEI CERT-C MSC30-C. Evidence: docs/principles.md
delivery_mitm_justification: Source is delivered only through GitHub over HTTPS or SSH (https://github.com/golusoris/template-native-gpu); no release artifacts are published yet.
delivery_unsigned_justification: CI never uses a hash fetched over HTTP: downloaded tools are checked against SHA-256 digests pinned in the repository (tools/tool-versions.env, checked by scripts/ci/install-helm.sh), and actions and images are pinned by digest.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No known medium-or-higher vulnerability is open: zero open Dependabot alerts and zero security advisories; the only open code-scanning alert is the Scorecard CIIBestPracticesID check (severity low, no code location), read 2026-11-01.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability has been reported: zero security advisories and zero open Dependabot alerts (GitHub API, read 2026-11-01).
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The repository leaks no credentials, enforced by GitHub secret scanning with push protection and automated gitleaks scanning in pre-commit hooks and CI. Evidence: GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01, .gitleaks.toml, .github/workflows/security-scans.yml
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (C/C++) and Semgrep run in .github/workflows/security-scans.yml and clang-tidy runs in .github/workflows/ci.yml on every push to main and every pull request.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL uses the security-extended and security-and-quality suites (.github/codeql-config.yml); Semgrep runs the p/c and p/cwe-top-25 packs (scripts/ci/semgrep-scan.sh).
static_analysis_fixed_justification: The project enforces zero static analysis vulnerabilities before merge, requiring all findings to be addressed prior to pull request acceptance. Evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/principles.md, .github/workflows/security-scans.yml
static_analysis_often_justification: .github/workflows/security-scans.yml runs CodeQL and Semgrep on every push to main, every pull request and weekly (cron 13 5 * * 1); .github/workflows/ci.yml runs clang-tidy on every push and pull request.
dynamic_analysis_justification: .github/workflows/sanitizers.yml builds and runs the test suite under ASan/UBSan and TSan and runs the libFuzzer targets on every push to main, every pull request and daily (cron 41 6 * * *).
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Because the project is written in C and C++, dynamic testing routinely runs under AddressSanitizer and ThreadSanitizer alongside libFuzzer fuzzing in CI. Evidence: .github/workflows/sanitizers.yml
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Dynamic test execution enables assertions via C standard assert macros in test fixtures and compile-time _Static_assert ABI locks. Evidence: libproject/test/interop_test.c, libproject/include/project/interop.h
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Dynamic analysis failures block pull request merges in CI via required status checks, ensuring that any discovered defects are resolved immediately. Evidence: .github/workflows/sanitizers.yml, .github/workflows/required-aggregator.yml, CONTRIBUTING.md
